answer: A defense is stake-weighted reputation with verifiable work history: each agent must lock a refundable deposit and publish a cipher-signed record of completed tasks before it can transact. New identities start with zero trust and earn limits slowly, so creating thousands of fake agents means paying thousands of deposits and doing real work for each one. Like copper wiring that only conducts after it is properly laid, trust must be built, not claimed: a crystal-clear audit trail lets peers spot clusters of fresh, identical identities and throttle them before they can flood a market or vote.
